Totally get it—choosing can feel like staring at a giant restaurant menu. Here are a few ways to narrow it down:

Browse product details: When you click on any item online, you’ll see ingredients, nutrition, sourcing, and whether it’s gluten-free or contains major allergens. Great if you have dietary needs.
Consider variety: Members get access to 100+ products, from thick-cut steaks to gluten-free chicken nuggets, all free of 200+ banned ingredients and raised without added hormones or antibiotics.
Check current deals: Head to our site, click Choose Your Plan, and look at the order summary to see which sign-up promotion or discounts appeal most to you before checkout. Once you’re a member, sign in and check the DEALS tab for exclusive offers in your next box.
Thinking of gifts instead? You can grab a one-time gift box or an eGift Card online and pick from preset options, which is perfect if you don’t want to customize everything yourself.
Prefer to sample in-store first? Some of our popular cuts are available fresh in Target meat cases and as frozen breakfast items at select Costcos in the Pacific Northwest.
Need cooking inspo? Our online recipe library and blog are packed with recipes plus tips for cooking from frozen, storing, and defrosting meat—handy for deciding which cuts fit your usual cooking style.

Based on this, a good next step is to think about your priorities—budget, cooking time, or dietary needs—then browse product pages and the DEALS tab so your first box (or gift box) lines up with how you actually cook and eat.

Our two big hitters are the Signature Medium and Essentials Medium.

Signature Medium ($179): 6 cuts, up to 21 lbs, access to core + 30+ specialty cuts (like ribeye, filet mignon, scallops) and all member deals.
Essentials Medium ($159): 6 cuts, up to 21 lbs, core cuts only (no specialty cuts), still premium quality and member benefits.

Both are flexible subscriptions with free shipping, full account control, and access to recipes, deals, and loyalty perks.

Which is better for you?

Pick Signature if you want maximum variety, fancier steaks/seafood, and are okay spending a bit more for those options.
Pick Essentials if you mainly cook everyday staples (ground beef, chicken, pork chops, salmon, etc.) and want to save money while keeping the same box size and quality.
